name: The Five Throats
vestige: Great Taar Haak, the five-throated war
summary: Strength +4 (up to 22) and 1 more Hit Point per level. The price: Intelligence -2, Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and a rage that won't stop at surrender.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_faceless_god (the ring of amber).

benefit.text: Your arms thicken, your neck with them. Doors give, chains give, people give.

cost.flaw: Once you have drawn blood you cannot stop while anything within reach is still standing, including whatever is begging.
cost.text: Five voices argue in your skull about whom to kill first. It makes careful thought harder, and it makes you very easy to provoke.
